mission.title: argo: Support `ignoreDifferences` as a resource annotation
mission.description: Support `ignoreDifferences` as a resource annotation. Requested by 112+ users.

steps.title: Check current argo deployment
steps.description:
Verify your argo version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n argo -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo
helm list -n argo 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working argo installation.

steps.title: Review argo configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant argo configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n argo -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo
kubectl get configmap -n argo -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=argo
```
It would be great if the Application spec `ignoreDifferences` could be supported at the individual resource level, perhaps as an annotation.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Support `ignoreDifferences` as a resource annotation
steps.description:
I am in favor of closing this with the solution provided by . IMO, this proposal is adding a feature for a bad practice. Sometimes we use open-source charts and operator that function in a certain way and we have to deal with it.

In this case, there are already multiple ways to fix the issue, with
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: my-dynamic-config
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/ignore-differences: /data/config
data:
  config: ''
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n argo -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo
kubectl get events -n argo --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Support `ignoreDifferences` as a resource annotation" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary: I am in favor of closing this with the solution provided by . IMO, this proposal is adding a feature for a bad practice. Sometimes we use open-source charts and operator that function in a certain way and we have to deal with it.
codeSnippets:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: my-dynamic-config
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/ignore-differences: /data/config
data:
  config: ''

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: my-dynamic-config
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/ignore-differences: |-
      jsonPointers:
      - /data/config
data:
  config: ''

# ignore changes to the spec when annotation is present
ignoreDifferences:
  - group: "*"
    kind: "*"
    jqPathExpressions:
    - .metadata?.annotations?["custom.argocd.argoproj.io/ignore-spec"] as $ignoreSpec | if $ignoreSpec == "true" then .spec else {} end
# don't forget
syncPolicy:
  syncOptions:
  - RespectIgnoreDifferences=true

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with argo installed or the issue environment reproducible.
